senses.gloss: m. (denom. of כַּד II) a sort of lever with which a pitcher is fished out of the well; oth. opin.: a pitcher-stand, watercooler.—Pl. כַּדּוּמִים, כַּדּוּמִין.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 13:7">Kel. XIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Tevul Yom 4:6">T’bul Yom. IV, 6</cite>, v. <cite ref="A03344"><he>אַשְׁקְלוֹן</he></cite>.
